official_evidence.note: USDA ARS SR28 report identifies NDB 11207, Dandelion greens raw, Taraxacum officinale.

provenance_note: SR Legacy is an official USDA legacy data type, not Foundation Foods. It is accepted only because the database labels the data type explicitly; it is not presented as a 2026 Foundation record.
identity_limitation: Applies to the USDA record identified as Taraxacum officinale. Korean retail/wild plants called 민들레 must not be assumed identical without botanical identity confirmation.
